title: metadata-protocol: close the package-less write onto a packaged item (PUT/DELETE, rollback, source save, reset) naming <base>.custom; Studio drops its overlay link
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 (P1 close half, split from #28413 and cut 2026-11-01 on the maintainer's 「四项提速措施全部按推荐执行」, schedule reviewed); Q5 「全部同意」: package-less overlay writes are closed after the migration · plan of record: ADR-0146 Rollout P1 "N-16 migrate package-less overlay rows, then close that write". ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #28413, #28562, #28569

Part of #28236 (P1, child **N-16b**) · governs: ADR-0146 D11 (close), D1 (rollback, source save and reset only on the writable package); Supersede rows ADR-0005 five-type tier, ADR-0131 D6, ADR-0070 D5 · lane: `domain:server` (`packages/metadata-protocol`; console surface declared in item 3) · size: M.

**Business reason.** Once HotCRM's customizations live in `hotcrm.custom`, a write of no package is the last way to make a change that never exports. This card closes it, after Studio edits every type that loses its Setup overlay (N-17, N-25).

**Measured (`35b178bd0a`).**
- `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts:56#refusePackagedBaseOverride` refuses a package-less write only for a sealed item. The five `allowEnvironmentOverlay` types pass, and `flow` is sealed already, so N-18 is not needed here.
- `protocol-environment-rows.ts:152#packagelessAddress` is the address of the direct save, the delete and the version token. The class method's docblock (`protocol.ts:17650`) names `saveMetaItem`, `deleteMetaItem` and `readVersionToken`; the draft doors use `packagelessDraftAddress`.
- **Reset and delete of a migrated item before the close:** after #28413's move the pair's row is the sole binding. A package-less `DELETE` (Setup's "Reset overlay") therefore removes the pair's row (`protocol.ts:2875#servedOverlayRowCandidates` and its docblock from :2802). #28413's item 4 keeps the row's `overrides` on a package-less save in that window; this card retires that allowance with the write.
- **After the close:** a `DELETE` naming `?package=<base>.custom` is not package-less and stays open. Who offers it:
  - Setup's item page with `?package=` (`ResourceEditPage.tsx:535` `ownerPackageId`; the reset sends `packageId`, about :2142), until N-28 retires the route;
  - N-17's "Restore package original" for view, dashboard and report (D2 revert);
  - N-25 for translation and email template.
  Not verified in a running console.
- Studio link: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:843` draws `engine.studio.pkg.readonlyLink` whenever the type has `allowEnvironmentOverlay`.
- Pins of today's open write: `objectql/src/environment-overlay-five-types.test.ts`, `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts`.

**Wanted.**
1. **Close.** A package-less `PUT` / `DELETE` onto a shipped name is refused, naming `<base>.custom` and #28413's ceremony. This includes rollback, source save and reset (D1).
   - `packagelessAddress` stops answering an unbound binding for a shipped name.
   - `allowEnvironmentOverlay` stops opening a write door. It stays the predicate the migration and the read of an unmigrated row use.
2. **Unmigrated rows** stay served, unchanged. Their package-less write is refused with the same sentence, which names the ceremony.
3. **Console** (`ui/packages/app-shell`, one surface): the Studio link stops offering the overlay for a packaged item. Setup's overlay save shows the server's refusal verbatim until N-28 retires the route.
4. **PR declarations:** `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, a **major** changeset with its ADR-0087 disposition. The body carries the migration FROM → TO: a package-less write onto a shipped name becomes a write naming `?package=<base>.custom`. The release note tells operators to run #28413's `os migrate` ceremony **before** upgrading to this release.

**Tests.**
- A package-less write after the close is refused naming the pair: `PUT`, `DELETE`, rollback and source save.
- A save and a `DELETE` naming `?package=<base>.custom` on a migrated item succeed.
- Control: a package-less write of a name no package ships (environment metadata) still succeeds.
- An unmigrated row is served, and its package-less write is refused naming the ceremony.
- `environment-overlay-five-types.test.ts` and `protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts` are re-judged. `protocol.org-scoped-write-refused.test.ts` stays green, unchanged.
- Console: no overlay link on a packaged item, and Setup shows the refusal sentence as sent.

**Release safety.** A release right after this card keeps an editor for every former overlay type: N-17 and N-25 are in `Blocked-by:`, and #28413 supplies the ceremony. A deployment that skipped the ceremony serves its rows but cannot edit them package-less, hence item 4's release note.

**Not here.** The migration (#28413); Studio customization (N-17, N-25); flow customization (N-18, not an overlay type); Setup redirects (N-28).

**Dedupe.** #28413 (its Wanted 4–5 moved here). Searched open issues `package-less write close` (12 hits) and `allowEnvironmentOverlay` (7 hits): #28413 and #28410 (the override gate), the rest QA runs, seats and test budgets. No other card closes the write.

Links back: #28236, #28413, ADR-0146 D1, D11, ADR-0005, ADR-0070 D5, ADR-0131 D6.
